Package jp.osscons.opensourcecobol.libcobj.sql

Class CobolDataConverter

java.lang.Object
jp.osscons.opensourcecobol.libcobj.sql.CobolDataConverter
public final class CobolDataConverter extends Object
Converts between COBOL host variable storage and Java/JDBC types.

    • cobolToString

      public static String cobolToString(AbstractCobolField field)
      Convert a COBOL host variable to its string representation for SQL binding.
      Parameters:
      field - the COBOL host variable field
      Returns:
      the string representation, or empty string if field is null

    • stringToCobolRaw

      public static void stringToCobolRaw(AbstractCobolField field, CobolDataStorage storage, int length, byte[] resultData)
      Write SQL result data to a specific COBOL storage location. Used for OCCURS arrays where the storage offset varies per row.
      Parameters:
      field - the COBOL field (for type resolution)
      storage - the target storage location
      length - the field byte length
      resultData - the SQL result data as bytes

    • stringToCobol

      public static void stringToCobol(AbstractCobolField field, byte[] resultData)
      Write SQL result data back to a COBOL host variable field.
      Parameters:
      field - the target COBOL field
      resultData - the SQL result data as bytes

    • setParam

      public static void setParam(PreparedStatement stmt, int index, ParameterMetaData metaData, AbstractCobolField field) throws SQLException
      Bind a COBOL host variable value to a JDBC PreparedStatement parameter.
      Parameters:
      stmt - the JDBC prepared statement
      index - the 1-based parameter index
      metaData - parameter metadata for type inference (may be null)
      field - the COBOL host variable field to bind
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a JDBC error occurs

    • getValueFromResultSet

      public static byte[] getValueFromResultSet(ResultSet rs, int columnIndex)
      Extract a column value from a ResultSet as SHIFT-JIS encoded bytes.
      Parameters:
      rs - the JDBC result set positioned on the current row
      columnIndex - the 1-based column index
      Returns:
      the column value as a byte array, or null if the value is SQL NULL
